name: Pafu Pafu Asobinin Chikan Jigoku
original_name: ぱふぱふ遊び人痴漢地獄
source:
A female good-off (Jester) in bunny-girl uniform comes to the real world from the world of DQ. She gets on a train, and finds a group of men getting turned on as seeing her voluptuous appearance.
